machine.accepting: array of unique integer states, may be empty
machine.transitions: array of n objects with exact keys zero, one, epsilon; each maps to unique integer-state array, which may be empty. No implicit sink, probabilities, regex syntax or deletion of invalid entries.
machine.word: string of0 and1 only, length0..24. Empty string means epsilon; literal epsilon glyph, spaces, other symbols refused.

semantics.closure: All states reachable by zero or more epsilon edges, including seeds. Cycles terminate through visited-state tracking.
semantics.trace: Initial active set is epsilon closure of start. Per symbol: union all matching symbol destinations, then epsilon close. Record raw moved set and resulting active set separately. Accept iff final active set intersects accepting, after all symbols.
semantics.construction: Start with closed start subset. Breadth-first reachable subsets, symbol0 before1, canonical sorted member sets, unique subset identities. Two transitions per reachable subset; empty subset included only if reachable and then self-loops. At most2^n<=32 subsets. A subset accepts iff any member accepts.
semantics.proof: Reachable-subset construction preserves the complete recognized language by the active-set induction invariant, not just agreement on tested words. It is not minimization. UI traces are bounded to24 symbols; the constructed transition graph is complete for all finite binary words.
